title: Price observation
description: One point on a price series: a value read from a named source at a known time. This is the entity behind db/schema/pg-schema.sql `price_history(ts, symbol, source, price)` - whose unique key is currently (symbol, ts, source), i.e. SYMBOL-AS-IDENTITY, the one schema-level violation of the identity rule; instrument_id is this contract's fix. Named Price series in the repo that are NOT this entity: markets MarkPrice (a venue-published mark) and IndexPrice (a venue-published index) - they are venue-published values and belong to the instrument's venue, not to a sampler.

received_at.description: Null while no carrier exists (see common/time.json).
